_comment: Rule-based placement tables for build_ia.py (and the rules fallback in poll.py).
Copy to routing.json and edit — routing.json is gitignored, since group ids and
the sites you annotate are personal. `python3 scripts/bootstrap_routing.py` will
draft one for you from your own Hypothesis groups.
node_for() checks these in order, first match wins:
1. artifact_domains        exact netloc -> node (things you wrote; beats group)
2. group_domain_overrides  group + substring of netloc -> node
Nodes must be ids defined in architecture/ia.md. Anything unmatched lands in
default_node, where Sonnet still gets a say — the rules are only a prior.
